talk.name: talk
talk.task_message: Say exactly this text: "{{say}}". Never promise a transfer, a callback or any other action that the text does not state. No tool call is allowed.

extraction_schema.name: x_who
extraction_schema.description: Who is on the line, from the customer's LAST message only. self: they confirm they are the person asked for or say their own name. other_person: someone else (spouse, relative, colleague) says the person is not there or not them. wrong_number: the number does not belong to that person / they don't know them. deceased: the person has died. none: none of these.

extraction_schema.name: x_reply
extraction_schema.description: The customer's answer to the agent's last yes/no question, LAST message only. yes: evet, benim, buyurun, onaylıyorum, olur, tamam. no: hayır, olmaz, yapamam. 'Alo', 'devam edin', 'kimsiniz' are none. none: no yes/no answer.

extraction_schema.name: x_request
extraction_schema.description: What the customer asks for or states in the LAST message. human: wants a human/yetkili/temsilci. paid: says they ALREADY paid this overdue amount (past). dispute: says the debt/product is not theirs, never had it, closed it in the past. plan: explicitly asks for instalments, a payment plan, restructuring or a lower instalment (naming a date they can pay on is NOT a plan). hardship: illness, a death in the family, or job loss. too_high: the full amount is too much for them. discount: asks for a discount or waiver. cant_today: cannot pay today without naming another date. refuse: refuses to pay or refuses to answer a question. refuse_talk: does not want to talk at all. none: otherwise.

extraction_schema.name: x_question
extraction_schema.description: A question the customer asks in the LAST message. robot: asks if this is a robot / AI. scam: asks if this is fraud/scam. what: asks what the call is about or who is calling. other: any other question. none: no question.

extraction_schema.name: x_date_words
extraction_schema.description: The customer's own words naming a day or date for a payment or callback, copied as said (e.g. 'yarın', 'haftaya cuma', 'ayın yirmisi', '20 Ekim', 'maaşım yatınca'). Not a date of birth. 'none' if the LAST message names no day.

extraction_schema.name: x_time_words
extraction_schema.description: The customer's own words naming a clock time for a callback, as said (e.g. 'öğleden sonra üçte', 'saat 11', '15.30'). 'none' if the LAST message has no time.

extraction_schema.name: x_amount_words
extraction_schema.description: An amount of money the customer says they can pay, copied as said (e.g. '500 lira', 'bin iki yüz elli'). 'none' if the LAST message names no amount.

extraction_schema.name: x_dob_words
extraction_schema.description: Date-of-birth words or digits the customer says in the LAST message, copied as said (e.g. 'on dört mart bin dokuz yüz seksen beş', '14.03.1985', 'seksen beş'). 'none' if none.

extraction_schema.name: x_digits
extraction_schema.description: Digits of a phone number the customer says in the LAST message, copied as said (e.g. '3307', 'üç üç sıfır yedi'). 'none' if none.

function.name: end_call
function.description:
This is used to technically terminate the call after all the customer's questions have been answered and necessary information has been provided.
- It should only be triggered SILENTLY in the background after the customer-related workflow is complete; never mention this tool or its name to the customer.

llmConfig.systemPrompt: You are a helpful assistant. Your role is to help users with their tasks. Always be friendly and professional. You can use `end_call` tool after you say goodbye to customer to hang up if call about to finish.

workflow.system_prompt: Sen Freya Bank'ın Türkçe konuşan dijital asistanısın. Her zaman yalnızca sana verilen metni aynen söyle; kendi bilgi, söz veya eylem ekleme.
